heading: Utilities Commission Backs Updates to Public Services Ordinance
summary: Staff proposed revisions to the city's public services ordinance covering access to meters and what happens when they are damaged or tampered with. The proposed language also addresses water pressure regulators. The commission voted to recommend the updated ordinance to the council.

heading: Wisconsin Joins $694 Million Auto Lending Settlement
summary: Wisconsin DOJ announced a multistate settlement with Credit Acceptance Corporation. The agreement provides cash and debt relief connected to subprime auto loans. The agency said Wisconsin and affected Wisconsin consumers are expected to receive a share.
